### call 1: node=spark-1 timeout=30 check=False
set -eu
unit=dgx-model-production.service
script_path='/home/operator/load example.sh'
expected_hash=eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee
test -r "$script_path"
bash -n "$script_path"
actual_hash=$(sha256sum "$script_path" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$actual_hash" = "$expected_hash"
if systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$unit"; then
  printf '%s\n' 'already-running'
  exit 0
fi
systemctl --user reset-failed "$unit" 2>/dev/null || true
systemd-run --user --unit=dgx-model-production --collect \
  --property=KillMode=control-group \
  --property=Restart=no \
  --property=TimeoutStopSec=60 \
  /bin/bash "$script_path"
### end
